Una misión europea detecta indicios de volcanes activos bajo la superficie de Marte: "No están muertos, solo dormidos"
es.description: Siempre se ha dicho que Marte es ahora un mundo volcánicamente muerto. Y eso que, según indican varios trabajos, en su juventud el planeta rojo fue un lugar con mucha actividad volcánica y tectónica hasta que, con el paso del tiempo, acabó apagándose. Pero ¿y si no fuera exactamente así? Tras años en la órbita marciana, la misión europea Exomars anuncia que ha detectado la presencia de gases volcánicos filtrándose por las grietas de la superficie, lo que, en opinión de los expertos, indicaría la existencia de volcanes activos bajo el subsuelo de Marte. En un artículo publicado este miércoles en la revista 'Science Advances', los científicos a cargo de esta detección afirman que, de confirmarse, estos indicios podrían demostrar que los volcanes marcianos nunca murieron, sino que simplemente estarían durmiendo.

it.title: Leonardo Pieraccioni "L'IA non l'avrà vinta, anzi ci invidia"
it.description: AGI - Leonardo Pieraccioni torna al cinema con "Un weekend artificiale", commedia che mescola fantascienza e sentimenti, in sala dal 12 novembre con Vision Distribution. Il regista e attore toscano, che firma e interpreta il film, e con Giulia Vecchio, protagonista nei panni di un umanoide al suo fianco, ha rilasciato un'intervista all'AGI. La fotografia di una fase della vita Il film, ha spiegato Pieraccioni, è la fotografia del momento che vive l'autore. "Ogni film rappresenta la Polaroid del momento che stai vivendo. Ho iniziato a 30 anni a raccontare dei laureati fuori corso che non sapevano quale fosse la loro strada, poi ho raccontato l'amore che arriva all'improvviso, poi l'amore che ha fatto fatica a essere sostenuto... A 60 anni incominci a capire le cose che valgono e le cose che invece hanno meno peso". L'intelligenza artificiale che invidia gli esseri umani Al centro della storia c'è un umanoide creato con l'intelligenza artificiale, con un capovolgimento: sono le macchine a invidiare noi. "Mi piaceva raccontare questo stato d'animo con l'argomento principe che ci accompagnerà per i prossimi anni, questa intelligenza artificiale, sostenendo però che la ragazza, intendendo l'intelligenza artificiale, ci invidia, vorrebbe avere le nostre paturnie, vorrebbe avere le nostre debolezze. Vorrebbe uscire dal telefonino e andarsi a mangiare la pizza con un bel trentasettenne. L'umanità e l'uomo saranno sempre più accesi rispetto a una risposta fredda", ha dichiarato il regista fiorentino. Giulia Vecchio: «Un viaggio come quello di un bambino» Per Vecchio, interpretare un essere privo di memoria e di identità ha richiesto un approccio essenziale, quasi infantile. "Non avendo dei ricordi, non avendo un'identità, il viaggio è stato molto basilare. Quali sono le cose che mi piacerebbe sapere? Che cos'è l'amore? Che cosa vuol dire dare un bacio, avere un legame con una persona? È stato proprio un viaggio di un bambino che chiede centomila 'perché'. Mi sono detta che l'intelligenza artificiale non ha nulla: è come quando dopo un trauma ci si sente totalmente resettati", ha spiegato l'attrice. I rischi dell'IA e il paragone con il Bimby Alla domanda sulla regolamentazione dell'IA e sui rischi per il mondo artistico, Pieraccioni ha risposto con una battuta: "Noi siamo misoneisti, abbiamo sempre paura delle novità. Si trova un articolo a Firenze di quando misero l'illuminazione alla stazione, insorsero tutti. L'intelligenza artificiale è un meraviglioso Bimby, ma riempito da quelli che sono i nostri sentimenti e si nutre di quello che le dici. Bisogna stare attenti come per lo scrollamento eccessivo sul telefono, ma l'intelligenza artificiale non l'avrà vinta".

gr.title: «Βάλτε τα λεφτά να τελειώνουμε, μην το κουράζουμε άλλο»: Ο διάλογος Φιρινίδη με δωρητή, ηχητικό ντοκουμέντο
gr.description: Αποκαλυπτικός είναι ο διάλογος του Κωνσταντίνου Φιρινίδη που κατηγορείται για την υπόθεση της ΜΚΟ «Παιδική Χαρά» με δωρητή. Σε ηχητικό ντοκουμέντο, που έφερε στο φως της δημοσιότητας, η εκπομπή Live News του Mega, ο Κωνσταντίνος Φιρινίδης συνομιλεί με δωρητή και του ζητά επιτακτικά να προχωρήσει σε κατάθεση. Η υπόθεση φέρεται να ξεκίνησε όταν ένα ζευγάρι αποφάσισε να διοργανώσει εκδήλωση με φιλανθρωπικό σκοπό, προκειμένου να ενισχυθεί ένα άρρωστο παιδί μέσω της ΜΚΟ «Παιδική Χαρά». Ωστόσο, η εμπλοκή πολιτιστικών συλλόγων στη διοργάνωση φαίνεται πως προκάλεσε καθυστέρηση περίπου 15 ημερών στην καταβολή των χρημάτων. Μια εξέλιξη που, σύμφωνα με τις καταγγελίες, προκάλεσε την έντονη δυσαρέσκεια του ιδιοκτήτη της ΜΚΟ, ο οποίος φέρεται να ζητούσε με επιτακτικό και έντονο ύφος την άμεση κατάθεση του ποσού στον τραπεζικό λογαριασμό. «Με έχετε κουράσει λίγο με αυτή την υπόθεση. Μπούρου, μπούρου, μπούρου. Βάλτε τα λεφτά να τελειώνουμε, γιατί έχετε κουράσει. Ειλικρινά σου το λέω. Βάλτε τα λεφτά, αφήστε τις δικαιολογίες. Με 1.000 ευρώ δεν θα σωθείτε. Δεν έχεις να μου πεις κάτι κι έχω πάρα πολλές δουλειές. Είμαι στο γραφείο, δεν μπορώ να μιλάω όλη μέρα γι’ αυτό. Δηλαδή το έχουμε κουράσει το θέμα», ακούγεται να λέει ο Κωνσταντίνος Φιρινίδης. Ο διάλογος του Φιρινίδη με δωρητή Φιρινίδης: Τσάμπα λέμε, λέμε, λέμε τα ίδια πράγματα τόσες μέρες. Βάλε τα λεφτά να τελειώνουμε. Μη το κουράζουμε άλλο. Δωρητής: Βρε συ θα τα πάρει απλά θέλει μια διαδικασία. Αν την έκανα εγώ σαν [όνομα] την άλλη μέρα στο ΙBAN θα φεύγανε κατευθείαν. Αυτοί στους συλλόγους εδώ έχουν άλλη διαδικασία, δεν την ξέρω. Δεν έχω εμπλακεί ποτέ με συλλόγους χορευτικούς. Φιρινίδης: Τότε να μην λένε λόγια ρε συ. Κάθεται και λέει στην μαμά (άρρωστου παιδιού): “Ο Κώστας είναι το πρόβλημα κι έπρεπε να το κάνουμε εμείς οι δύο”. Δεν θα αφήσω τίποτα στην τύχη επειδή είμαι πάρα πολύ εγωιστής όταν μου πατάνε τον κάλο. Δεν θα το επιτρέψω εγώ να είμαι και κερατάς και δαρμένος. Ο Κωνσταντίνος Φιρινίδης αναμένεται να απολογηθεί την Πέμπτη, ενώ προφυλακιστέα μετά την απολογία της κρίθηκε η σύντροφός του Βασιλική Μανησιώτη. Στην κατάθεσή της επέρριψε την ευθύνη στον Φιρινίδη για τα ποσά που φέρονται να υπεξαιρέθηκαν. Τον περιέγραψε, δε, ως έναν άνθρωπο εθισμένο στον τζόγο. Σε βάρος των κατηγορουμένων έχει ασκηθεί από το Σάββατο κακουργηματική δίωξη για τα κατά περίπτωση αδικήματα της απάτης από κοινού και κατ' εξακολούθηση, τετελεσμένης και σε απόπειρα, της υπεξαίρεσης, της νομιμοποίησης εσόδων από εγκληματικές δραστηριότητες από δράστες που ενεργούν κατ' επάγγελμα, από κοινού και κατά μόνας, της δωροδοκίας και δωροληψίας για αλλοίωση αποτελέσματος αγώνα, καθώς και της συμμορίας. in.title: New Independent Research Names Omnicom Media a Leader in Media Management Services
in.description: Report: "Omnicom Media is best for enterprises seeking to integrate media, commerce, identity, and creative on a common technology foundation" NEW YORK, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, has been named a "Leader" among global media management services providers in a new analysis from leading research and advisory firm Forrester. Published today, The Forrester Wave™: Media Management Services, Q4 2026 evaluated the 12 most significant media management service providers against 19 criteria specific to current offering and strategy. Designed to help CMO professionals select the right provider for their needs, the report assesses the media groups under three designations: Leaders, Strong Performers, and Contenders. With the highest possible scores (5) across seven criteria, Omnicom Media was one of three of the 12 providers evaluated to receive designation as a "Leader". Under the current offering category, OMG received 5/5 scores in four of the 13 criteria, including data/marketing sciences, commerce media, media buying, and principal- media buying. Additionally, OMG received the highest possible scores in three out of the six criteria within the strategy category, including innovation, partner ecosystem, and global delivery strategy. According to the evaluation, "Strong technology, IPG integration, and go-to-market strategy underpin Omnicom's exemplary account-led orchestration";1 while reference customers "value Omnicom's co-creation model" and "note its negotiating power as a defense against media inflation"2 - an assessment that to Omnicom Media aligns with its status as the world's largest global media management group, with more than $75 billion in billings. Strategy and Capabilities Powered by Omni In the strategy analysis, Forrester's evaluation states that Omnicom Media "translates partnerships into repeatable client value, including an industry-specialized agentic operating model codeveloped with Adobe and integrated into Omni, its proprietary marketing operating system"3 and that its "substantial AI investment demonstrates a commitment to innovation."4 From a capabilities standpoint, the report notes that "Omnicom excels at turning audience intelligence and data science into buying leverage and integrated execution"5 while "the combination of Acxiom identity and Flywheel Commerce Cloud strengthens commerce media through unified data, SKU-level management, and sales attribution connected to compensation."6 (Omnicom Media is one of the world's largest buyers of retail media, managing more than $10 billion in retail media investment.) Summing up the key takeaway for brands, Forrester's profile on Omnicom Media concludes, "Omnicom Media is best for enterprises seeking to integrate media, commerce, identity, and creative on a common technology foundation."7 "In a marketplace being reshaped by AI, commerce and increasingly complex consumer journeys, we believe Forrester offers marketers a valuable perspective on what truly differentiates a leader: the ability to connect intelligence, technology, partnerships and buying power to deliver measurable business value," says Omnicom Media CEO Florian Adamski. "That's exactly what our Growth by Design strategy enables, bringing together the best talent, proprietary platforms and partner capabilities in a model built accelerate client ambitions and drive increased brand growth." th.description: ต่อจากนี้ไปนิสิตนักศึกษาที่ใกล้เรียนจบจะเตรียมตัวเข้าสู่โลกการทำงานจริงในอนาคตได้อย่างมั่นใจด้วยแอปพลิเคชันการจัดหางานพาร์ทไทม์ DAYWORK ซึ่งจะเป็นโปรไฟล์ให้ผู้จ้างงานได้อีกด้วย DAYWORK แอปพลิเคชันการจัดหางานพาร์ทไทม์ คว้ารางวัล “สุดยอดนวัตกรรม 7 Innovation Awards 2021 ประเภทรางวัลนวัตกรรมที่ก่อให้เกิดประโยชน์ต่อสังคม ซึ่งเป็นรางวัลที่มอบให้กับผลงานนวัตกรรมที่มีความโดดเด่นที่ได้ทดสอบหรือทดลองกับกลุ่มลูกค้าหรือผู้บริโภคในตลาดจริง ซึ่งการพัฒนาแอปพลิเคชันนี้ได้รับการสนับสนุนจากศูนย์กลางนวัตกรรมแห่งจุฬาลงกรณ์มหาวิทยาลัย (CU Innovation Hub) DAYWORK แพลตฟอร์มช่วยหางานพาร์ทไทม์และบริการจัดหาคนทำงานพาร์ทไทม์ พัฒนาโดยคุณศศิวิมล เสียงแจ้ว ซึ่งได้รับการสนับสนุนจากศูนย์กลางนวัตกรรมแห่งจุฬาลงกรณ์มหาวิทยาลัย (CU Innovation Hub) ซึ่งเป็นหน่วยงานของจุฬาฯ ที่ส่งเสริมการสร้างองค์ความรู้และนวัตกรรมต่างๆ ของคณาจารย์ นิสิตจุฬาฯ และนวัตกรจากภายนอกมหาวิทยาลัย สู่การพัฒนาอย่างยั่งยืนของสังคมไทย โดยมีผู้เชี่ยวชาญจากจุฬาฯ ให้ความรู้และคำแนะนำต่างๆ ที่เป็นประโยชน์ในการสร้างนวัตกรรมให้ประสบผลสำเร็จ คุณศศิวิมล เสียงแจ้ว ผู้ก่อตั้ง DAYWORK เล่าถึงจุดเริ่มต้นในการคิดค้นแอปพลิเคชันนี้ว่า “แรกเริ่มได้ทำเว็บไซต์เกี่ยวกับการฝึกงานของนักศึกษามาก่อนจึงได้มีโอกาสทำงานร่วมกับน้องๆ นิสิตนักศึกษา ทำให้เห็นว่ามีน้องๆ ที่สนใจหารายได้เพิ่มเติมระหว่างเรียนเป็นจำนวนมากจึงเริ่มต้นจัดทำแอปพลิเคชันช่วยหางานพาร์ทไทม์ เพื่อให้นิสิตนักศึกษามีโอกาสในการเข้าถึงงานที่ง่ายขึ้นโดยมีเป้าหมายให้การทำงานพาร์ทไทม์เป็นแบบยืดหยุ่น สามารถหาประสบการณ์จากการทำงานได้หลากหลายรูปแบบ โดยเริ่มต้นตั้งแต่การทำงานรายชั่วโมงเป็นต้นไป” สำหรับฟังชั่นการทำงานนั้น แอปพลิเคชันจะค้นหางานที่ใกล้กับสถานที่ที่เราอยู่ ไม่ว่าจะเป็นที่พักอาศัย ที่ทำงาน หรือสถานศึกษา แอปพลิเคชันจะแนะนำงานพาร์ทไทม์ให้ตาม Location ซึ่งเราสามารถสมัครเข้าใช้งานและสร้างโปรไฟล์เพียงครั้งเดียวก็จะสมัครงานได้ทุกตำแหน่งงานที่มีภายในแอปพลิเคชันได้ โดย DAYWORK […]

ph.title: New Independent Research Names Omnicom Media a Leader in Media Management Services
ph.description: Report: "Omnicom Media is best for enterprises seeking to integrate media, commerce, identity, and creative on a common technology foundation" NEW YORK, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, has been named a "Leader" among global media management services providers in a new analysis from leading research and advisory firm Forrester. Published today, The Forrester Wave™: Media Management Services, Q4 2026 evaluated the 12 most significant media management service providers against 19 criteria specific to current offering and strategy. Designed to help CMO professionals select the right provider for their needs, the report assesses the media groups under three designations: Leaders, Strong Performers, and Contenders. With the highest possible scores (5) across seven criteria, Omnicom Media was one of three of the 12 providers evaluated to receive designation as a "Leader". Under the current offering category, OMG received 5/5 scores in four of the 13 criteria, including data/marketing sciences, commerce media, media buying, and principal- media buying. Additionally, OMG received the highest possible scores in three out of the six criteria within the strategy category, including innovation, partner ecosystem, and global delivery strategy. According to the evaluation, "Strong technology, IPG integration, and go-to-market strategy underpin Omnicom's exemplary account-led orchestration";1 while reference customers "value Omnicom's co-creation model" and "note its negotiating power as a defense against media inflation"2 - an assessment that to Omnicom Media aligns with its status as the world's largest global media management group, with more than $75 billion in billings. Strategy and Capabilities Powered by Omni In the strategy analysis, Forrester's evaluation states that Omnicom Media "translates partnerships into repeatable client value, including an industry-specialized agentic operating model codeveloped with Adobe and integrated into Omni, its proprietary marketing operating system"3 and that its "substantial AI investment demonstrates a commitment to innovation."4 From a capabilities standpoint, the report notes that "Omnicom excels at turning audience intelligence and data science into buying leverage and integrated execution"5 while "the combination of Acxiom identity and Flywheel Commerce Cloud strengthens commerce media through unified data, SKU-level management, and sales attribution connected to compensation."6 (Omnicom Media is one of the world's largest buyers of retail media, managing more than $10 billion in retail media investment.) Summing up the key takeaway for brands, Forrester's profile on Omnicom Media concludes, "Omnicom Media is best for enterprises seeking to integrate media, commerce, identity, and creative on a common technology foundation."7 "In a marketplace being reshaped by AI, commerce and increasingly complex consumer journeys, we believe Forrester offers marketers a valuable perspective on what truly differentiates a leader: the ability to connect intelligence, technology, partnerships and buying power to deliver measurable business value," says Omnicom Media CEO Florian Adamski. "That's exactly what our Growth by Design strategy enables, bringing together the best talent, proprietary platforms and partner capabilities in a model built accelerate client ambitions and drive increased brand growth." Research Marketplace Momentum Receiving the designation as a Leader is the latest in a streak of good news for Omnicom Media, which in October alone won the North America media business for The Coca-Cola Company; was named the EMEA media AOR for Europe's biggest single advertiser, the Lidl retail chain; landed the global assignment for Lavazza coffee; and was awarded the L'oreal business in the DACH region. Adding this 30-day sprint to a 2026-win record that already included Adidas, CVS, Delta, Dyson, IBM, Novo Nordisk, Uber, and Xiaomi brings Omnicom Media's YTD total to more than $10 billion in billings won or retained through competitive pitches. Additionally, the latest edition of the Network Diagnostics report from RECMA (Research Company Evaluating the Media Agency Industry) published last month, Omnicom Media was again named the best performing global media group, topping both the global ranking as well as the regional rankings across North America, EMEA, APAC and LATAM. This marks the second consecutive report in which Omnicom Media has topped the Network Diagnostics report's global and regional rankings. Additionally, three Omnicom Media agencies - OMD, PHD and Initiative - were among the top five best performing global media agencies, with OMD topping the ranking for the 12th consecutive report. Concurrent with growing its client roster and topping industry performance rankings, Omnicom Media has also continued to expand its partner ecosystem in 2026, activating its co-creation model to launch first-to-market collaborations with Google, Meta & Walmart, Pinterest and Roku & Amazon designed to redefine how brands influence consumer decisions in the AI era; and with Disney, Netflix, NBCUniversal and Paramount that connect brand content to platform programming, viewing experiences, and consumer expectations and behaviors. "Our performance demonstrates what industry recognition looks like in a changing media marketplace," said Adamski. "From winning some of the world's most iconic and successful brands to building partnerships that open new opportunities for growth, we are translating our scale, talent, and technology into tangible client advantage. To us, the Forrester recognition reinforces the strength of that model and our ability to keep raising the bar for what media can deliver." Forrester does not endorse any company, product, brand, or service included in its research publications and does not advise any person to select the products or services of any company or brand based on the ratings included in such publications. Information is based on the best available resources. Opinions reflect judgment at the time and are subject to change. This report is part of a broader collection of Forrester resources, including interactive models, frameworks, tools, data, and access to analyst guidance. For more information, read about Forrester's objectivity here. About Omnicom Media Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, is the world's largest global media management network. Powered by the Omni Intelligence Platform, Omnicom Media agencies leverage $75.6 billion in billings, 47,000 specialists across 70+ markets, and the industry's most powerful portfolio identity, commerce, and intelligence assets to design dynamic Growth Ecosystems that enable the world's most ambitious businesses to grow faster and smarter. The Omnicom Media portfolio includes global media agency brands OMD, PHD, Initiative, Hearts United, and UM; core Omnicom Integrated Media offerings Acxiom, the world's premier identity solution, and the Flywheel end-to-end commerce solution; and specialty services across the cloud consulting, creator, financial, healthcare, and sports & entertainment categories. bd.title: New Independent Research Names Omnicom Media a Leader in Media Management Services
bd.description: Report: "Omnicom Media is best for enterprises seeking to integrate media, commerce, identity, and creative on a common technology foundation" NEW YORK, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, has been named a "Leader" among global media management services providers in a new analysis from leading research and advisory firm Forrester. Published today, The Forrester Wave™: Media Management Services, Q4 2026 evaluated the 12 most significant media management service providers against 19 criteria specific to current offering and strategy. Designed to help CMO professionals select the right provider for their needs, the report assesses the media groups under three designations: Leaders, Strong Performers, and Contenders. With the highest possible scores (5) across seven criteria, Omnicom Media was one of three of the 12 providers evaluated to receive designation as a "Leader". Under the current offering category, OMG received 5/5 scores in four of the 13 criteria, including data/marketing sciences, commerce media, media buying, and principal- media buying. Additionally, OMG received the highest possible scores in three out of the six criteria within the strategy category, including innovation, partner ecosystem, and global delivery strategy. According to the evaluation, "Strong technology, IPG integration, and go-to-market strategy underpin Omnicom's exemplary account-led orchestration";1 while reference customers "value Omnicom's co-creation model" and "note its negotiating power as a defense against media inflation"2 - an assessment that to Omnicom Media aligns with its status as the world's largest global media management group, with more than $75 billion in billings. Strategy and Capabilities Powered by Omni In the strategy analysis, Forrester's evaluation states that Omnicom Media "translates partnerships into repeatable client value, including an industry-specialized agentic operating model codeveloped with Adobe and integrated into Omni, its proprietary marketing operating system"3 and that its "substantial AI investment demonstrates a commitment to innovation."4 From a capabilities standpoint, the report notes that "Omnicom excels at turning audience intelligence and data science into buying leverage and integrated execution"5 while "the combination of Acxiom identity and Flywheel Commerce Cloud strengthens commerce media through unified data, SKU-level management, and sales attribution connected to compensation."6 (Omnicom Media is one of the world's largest buyers of retail media, managing more than $10 billion in retail media investment.) Summing up the key takeaway for brands, Forrester's profile on Omnicom Media concludes, "Omnicom Media is best for enterprises seeking to integrate media, commerce, identity, and creative on a common technology foundation."7 "In a marketplace being reshaped by AI, commerce and increasingly complex consumer journeys, we believe Forrester offers marketers a valuable perspective on what truly differentiates a leader: the ability to connect intelligence, technology, partnerships and buying power to deliver measurable business value," says Omnicom Media CEO Florian Adamski. "That's exactly what our Growth by Design strategy enables, bringing together the best talent, proprietary platforms and partner capabilities in a model built accelerate client ambitions and drive increased brand growth." Research Marketplace Momentum Receiving the designation as a Leader is the latest in a streak of good news for Omnicom Media, which in October alone won the North America media business for The Coca-Cola Company; was named the EMEA media AOR for Europe's biggest single advertiser, the Lidl retail chain; landed the global assignment for Lavazza coffee; and was awarded the L'oreal business in the DACH region. Adding this 30-day sprint to a 2026-win record that already included Adidas, CVS, Delta, Dyson, IBM, Novo Nordisk, Uber, and Xiaomi brings Omnicom Media's YTD total to more than $10 billion in billings won or retained through competitive pitches. Additionally, the latest edition of the Network Diagnostics report from RECMA (Research Company Evaluating the Media Agency Industry) published last month, Omnicom Media was again named the best performing global media group, topping both the global ranking as well as the regional rankings across North America, EMEA, APAC and LATAM. This marks the second consecutive report in which Omnicom Media has topped the Network Diagnostics report's global and regional rankings. Additionally, three Omnicom Media agencies - OMD, PHD and Initiative - were among the top five best performing global media agencies, with OMD topping the ranking for the 12th consecutive report. Concurrent with growing its client roster and topping industry performance rankings, Omnicom Media has also continued to expand its partner ecosystem in 2026, activating its co-creation model to launch first-to-market collaborations with Google, Meta & Walmart, Pinterest and Roku & Amazon designed to redefine how brands influence consumer decisions in the AI era; and with Disney, Netflix, NBCUniversal and Paramount that connect brand content to platform programming, viewing experiences, and consumer expectations and behaviors. "From winning some of the world's most iconic and successful brands to building partnerships that open new opportunities for growth, we are translating our scale, talent, and technology into tangible client advantage. bd.title: G Adventures reveals eight destinations to watch for 2027
bd.description: Annual forecast spotlights trending destinations driven by expanded air routes and new visa policies BRISBANE, Australia, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Community tourism pioneer G Adventures has unveiled its eight destinations to watch for 2027. Rather than driving traffic to overcrowded hotspots, the small-group travel operator is promoting conscious strategies that funnel travel dollars into local host communities beyond busy hubs. The 2027 forecast highlights regions benefiting from improved flight access, eased visa requirements, or surging demand for authentic cultural connection: China: Following expanded visa-free entry, bookings jumped 52% YoY, prompting G Adventures to launch nine new itineraries, including National Geographic Journeys and Signature. The 19-day Signature: China From the Great Wall to Shangri-La visits Dunhuang's Mogao Grottoes and Yumen Pass, featuring stays in fortress-style desert lodges. The Stans: Central Asia is booming, with bookings to Uzbekistan up 165%, becoming the top-booked region globally for the National Geographic Signature collection. The Stans: The Ultimate Silk Road Adventure takes travellers off-grid along Lake Issyk-Kul and Tajikistan's Fan Mountains with local homestays and yurt workshops. Sri Lanka: New direct flights are making Sri Lanka more accessible, prompting two new itineraries for 2027. The 12-day Sri Lanka Encompassed includes nature chalets in Digana, village farm walks, and hands-on local cooking classes. New Zealand: Back in the spotlight as a major filming backdrop (The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum and The Legend of Zelda), New Zealand is easier to explore thanks to Air New Zealand's 2027 regional expansion. The North Island Multisport spends two nights off-grid at Blue Duck Station, an eco-sanctuary protecting the endangered whio. Dominica: With a new international airport opening in 2027, Dominica is shifting from cruise day trips toward immersive stays. Geluxe itineraries offer active adventures, from hiking to Trafalgar Falls to swimming responsibly with resident sperm whales in a protected marine reserve. The Seychelles: Moving past resort enclaves, a new multi-island adventure brings a different perspective as one of the only places on Earth to see free-roaming giant tortoises. The eight-day Seychelles Geluxe trip explores Mahé, Praslin, and La Digue via foot, kayak, and catamaran. Greece: Countering island overtourism, G Adventures is steering travellers toward northern mainland wilderness and historical mountain regions. Hiking Northern Greece explores traditional mountain villages and Mount Olympus (inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2026) on foot. The Balkans: Albania (up 15%) and Bosnia & Herzegovina (up 59%) are surging as uncrowded Mediterranean alternatives. Hiking in Albania, Kosovo & Montenegro traverses the Valbona Valley and Rugova Canyon with family-run guesthouse stays. Read the full global list here. About G Adventures Offering over 1,000 small-group adventures in 100+ countries, G Adventures is committed to changing lives through travel by harnessing the power of community tourism. gadventures.com.

ae.title: New Independent Research Names Omnicom Media a Leader in Media Management Services
ae.description: Report: "Omnicom Media is best for enterprises seeking to integrate media, commerce, identity, and creative on a common technology foundation" NEW YORK, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, has been named a "Leader" among global media management services providers in a new analysis from leading research and advisory firm Forrester. Published today, The Forrester Wave™: Media Management Services, Q4 2026 evaluated the 12 most significant media management service providers against 19 criteria specific to current offering and strategy. Designed to help CMO professionals select the right provider for their needs, the report assesses the media groups under three designations: Leaders, Strong Performers, and Contenders. With the highest possible scores (5) across seven criteria, Omnicom Media was one of three of the 12 providers evaluated to receive designation as a "Leader". Under the current offering category, OMG received 5/5 scores in four of the 13 criteria, including data/marketing sciences, commerce media, media buying, and principal- media buying. Additionally, OMG received the highest possible scores in three out of the six criteria within the strategy category, including innovation, partner ecosystem, and global delivery strategy. According to the evaluation, "Strong technology, IPG integration, and go-to-market strategy underpin Omnicom's exemplary account-led orchestration";1 while reference customers "value Omnicom's co-creation model" and "note its negotiating power as a defense against media inflation"2 - an assessment that to Omnicom Media aligns with its status as the world's largest global media management group, with more than $75 billion in billings. Strategy and Capabilities Powered by Omni In the strategy analysis, Forrester's evaluation states that Omnicom Media "translates partnerships into repeatable client value, including an industry-specialized agentic operating model codeveloped with Adobe and integrated into Omni, its proprietary marketing operating system"3 and that its "substantial AI investment demonstrates a commitment to innovation."4 From a capabilities standpoint, the report notes that "Omnicom excels at turning audience intelligence and data science into buying leverage and integrated execution"5 while "the combination of Acxiom identity and Flywheel Commerce Cloud strengthens commerce media through unified data, SKU-level management, and sales attribution connected to compensation."6 (Omnicom Media is one of the world's largest buyers of retail media, managing more than $10 billion in retail media investment.) Summing up the key takeaway for brands, Forrester's profile on Omnicom Media concludes, "Omnicom Media is best for enterprises seeking to integrate media, commerce, identity, and creative on a common technology foundation."7 "In a marketplace being reshaped by AI, commerce and increasingly complex consumer journeys, we believe Forrester offers marketers a valuable perspective on what truly differentiates a leader: the ability to connect intelligence, technology, partnerships and buying power to deliver measurable business value," says Omnicom Media CEO Florian Adamski. "That's exactly what our Growth by Design strategy enables, bringing together the best talent, proprietary platforms and partner capabilities in a model built accelerate client ambitions and drive increased brand growth." Research Marketplace Momentum Receiving the designation as a Leader is the latest in a streak of good news for Omnicom Media, which in October alone won the North America media business for The Coca-Cola Company; was named the EMEA media AOR for Europe's biggest single advertiser, the Lidl retail chain; landed the global assignment for Lavazza coffee; and was awarded the L'oreal business in the DACH region. Adding this 30-day sprint to a 2026-win record that already included Adidas, CVS, Delta, Dyson, IBM, Novo Nordisk, Uber, and Xiaomi brings Omnicom Media's YTD total to more than $10 billion in billings won or retained through competitive pitches. Additionally, the latest edition of the Network Diagnostics report from RECMA (Research Company Evaluating the Media Agency Industry) published last month, Omnicom Media was again named the best performing global media group, topping both the global ranking as well as the regional rankings across North America, EMEA, APAC and LATAM. This marks the second consecutive report in which Omnicom Media has topped the Network Diagnostics report's global and regional rankings. Additionally, three Omnicom Media agencies - OMD, PHD and Initiative - were among the top five best performing global media agencies, with OMD topping the ranking for the 12th consecutive report. Concurrent with growing its client roster and topping industry performance rankings, Omnicom Media has also continued to expand its partner ecosystem in 2026, activating its co-creation model to launch first-to-market collaborations with Google, Meta & Walmart, Pinterest and Roku & Amazon designed to redefine how brands influence consumer decisions in the AI era; and with Disney, Netflix, NBCUniversal and Paramount that connect brand content to platform programming, viewing experiences, and consumer expectations and behaviors. "Our performance demonstrates what industry recognition looks like in a changing media marketplace," said Adamski. "From winning some of the world's most iconic and successful brands to building partnerships that open new opportunities for growth, we are translating our scale, talent, and technology into tangible client advantage. To us, the Forrester recognition reinforces the strength of that model and our ability to keep raising the bar for what media can deliver." Forrester does not endorse any company, product, brand, or service included in its research publications and does not advise any person to select the products or services of any company or brand based on the ratings included in such publications. Information is based on the best available resources. Opinions reflect judgment at the time and are subject to change. This report is part of a broader collection of Forrester resources, including interactive models, frameworks, tools, data, and access to analyst guidance. For more information, read about Forrester's objectivity here. About Omnicom Media Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, is the world's largest global media management network. Powered by the Omni Intelligence Platform, Omnicom Media agencies leverage $75.6 billion in billings, 47,000 specialists across 70+ markets, and the industry's most powerful portfolio identity, commerce, and intelligence assets to design dynamic Growth Ecosystems that enable the world's most ambitious businesses to grow faster and smarter. The Omnicom Media portfolio includes global media agency brands OMD, PHD, Initiative, Hearts United, and UM; core Omnicom Integrated Media offerings Acxiom, the world's premier identity solution, and the Flywheel end-to-end commerce solution; and specialty services across the cloud consulting, creator, financial, healthcare, and sports & entertainment categories. sa.title: أفراح جازان تحيي الفنون الشعبية
sa.description: تتحول ساحات عدد من الأحياء السكنية في منطقة جازان إلى مساحات للاحتفال بالفنون الشعبية خلال مناسبات الزواج، بمشاركة الأهالي من مختلف الأعمار، وسط حضور للأهازيج والإيقاعات التراثية والأزياء التقليدية، في مشهد يجمع بين فرحة الزواج والمحافظة على الموروث الثقافي والاجتماعي للمنطقة.ورصدت «الوطن» خلال جولة ميدانية حضور الفنون الشعبية والعروض الأدائية في احتفالات الزواج داخل الأحياء، بمشاركة الشباب والأطفال وكبار السن، ما يمنح هذه المناسبات طابعًا اجتماعيًا يتجاوز الاحتفال بالعروسين إلى اجتماع سكان الحي والأحياء المجاورة.وأوضح المواطن طلال بغدادي، أن الاحتفالات تبدأ من فترة العصر وتمتد حتى منتصف الليل، مشيرًا إلى تنظيم فعاليات داخل الأحياء السكنية احتفاءً بالشباب المقبلين على الزواج.وتتيح هذه المناسبات للفنانين الشعبيين تقديم عروضهم أمام الأهالي، كما تجمع الأجيال المختلفة حول الفنون والأهازيج المحلية، وتسهم في تعريف الأطفال والشباب بالموروث الفني للمنطقة، وتعزيز التواصل الاجتماعي بين سكان الأحياء.

sa.title: زيارة الرئيس السوري.. تنسيق وتوافق في القضايا الإقليمية والدولية
sa.description: استقبل صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير محمد بن سلمان بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود ولي العهد رئيس مجلس الوزراء رئيس الجمهورية العربية السورية أحمد الشرع في الرياض. وأشاد سمو ولي العهد ورئيس الجمهورية العربية السورية بالتوافق الكبير في المواقف ووجهات النظر حيال القضايا الإقليمية والدولية ذات الاهتمام المشترك، بما يعكس عمق التنسيق والتشاور القائم بين البلدين. أمن الملاحة البحرية وأكد أهمية تعزيز الجهود الإقليمية والدولية الرامية إلى خفض التصعيد واحتواء الأزمات، وتغليب لغة الحوار والدبلوماسية، وتسوية الخلافات بالوسائل السلمية. وشددا على ضرورة الوقف الفوري لجميع الأعمال التي تهدد أمن الملاحة البحرية والممرات المائية في البحر الأحمر ومضيق باب المندب، ومضيق هرمز. زيارة الرئيس السوري وعقد سمو ولي العهد والرئيس السوري جلسة مباحثات استعرضا خلالها العلاقات الثنائية الوثيقة بين البلدين، وسبل تطويرها في المجالات كافة، وتم تبادل وجهات النظر حول مجمل الأوضاع الإقليمية والدولية الراهنة بما في ذلك التداعيات الخطيرة لأي تصعيد عسكري على الأمن والاستقرار الإقليمي والدولي، وسلامة الملاحة الدولية، واستدامة إمدادات الطاقة، واستقرار الاقتصاد العالمي. جرى خلال الزيارة التوقيع على عدد من مذكرات تفاهم واتفاقيات تعاون.

أبو كلل يطرح 3 مبادرات عراقية لتطوير العمل الإعلامي العربي المشترك
iq.description: شفق نيوز- بغداد طرح رئيس الجهاز التنفيذي لهيئة الإعلام والاتصالات، بليغ أبو كلل، يوم الأربعاء، 3 مبادرات عراقية لتطوير العمل الإعلامي العربي المشترك. وقال أبو كلل، في كلمة له، خلال ترؤسه وفد جمهورية العراق في أعمال الدورة العادية الـ56 لمجلس وزراء الإعلام العرب، المنعقدة بمقر الأمانة العامة لجامعة الدول العربية في القاهرة، بمشاركة وزراء الإعلام ورؤساء الوفود العربية، إن "العراق يرفض توظيف بعض المنابر الإعلامية العربية للتحريض والإساءة إلى الدول ومؤسساتها، مشيراً إلى استضافة شخصيات مطلوبة للقضاء العراقي أو صدرت بحقها أحكام قضائية، ومنح بعضها مساحات إعلامية لتقديم مواقفها وكأنها تمثل الرأي العام العراقي". وأضاف أن "العراق لا يطالب بمنع النقد أو التضييق على الآراء المخالفة، وإنما يدعو إلى التمييز بين حرية التعبير المشروعة والتحريض والإساءة، ومراعاة الأوضاع القضائية الموثقة عند استضافة الشخصيات الإعلامية والسياسية، وفق قوانين الدول المعنية وبما يكفل حق الرد". وفي إطار المقترحات العراقية، دعا أبو كلل إلى اعتماد آلية عربية لمتابعة تطبيق ميثاق الشرف الإعلامي لعام 2025، تتضمن تحديد نقاط اتصال وطنية في الدول الأعضاء، وإعداد تقرير سنوي عن الالتزام بالميثاق، ووضع دليل إرشادي موحد للمعايير المهنية. وجدد أبو كلل دعم العراق للقضية الفلسطينية وإدانته استهداف الصحفيين والإعلاميين، مقترحاً إنشاء أرشيف رقمي عربي مشترك لتوثيق انتهاكات الاحتلال بحق الإعلاميين والمؤسسات الإعلامية في فلسطين، بالتعاون مع الاتحادات الإعلامية العربية ووفق معايير تحقق رقمية معتمدة. كما دعا إلى إعداد إطار مهني عربي لاستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي في المؤسسات الإعلامية، وإطلاق برنامج تدريبي مشترك في التحقق الرقمي والتحليل الجنائي للمحتوى، مستعرضاً تجربة الهيأة في تدريب قياداتها وملاكاتها على تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي وأدواته. وفي الملف البيئي، استعرض أبو كلل الاستراتيجية الوطنية للإعلام البيئي التي وقعتها الهيأة مؤخراً، والهادفة إلى تطوير قدرات الصحفيين وتبسيط البيانات المناخية وتوظيف الذكاء الاصطناعي في التوعية البيئية، مؤكداً استعداد العراق لمشاركة تجربته بعد استكمال اعتمادها حكومياً. وشدد رئيس الجهاز التنفيذي على أهمية الانتقال من إصدار القرارات والمواثيق العربية إلى وضع آليات عملية لتنفيذها وقياس نتائجها، مؤكداً استعداد العراق للمساهمة بخبراته وملاكاته في تنفيذ المبادرات المقترحة وعرض ما ينجزه أمام المجلس في دورته المقبلة.

za.title: Eritrea: Meeting on Strengthening Organization of War-Disabled Veterans in Massawa
za.description: The National Association of Eritrean War-Disabled Veterans conducted a meeting on 1 November in Massawa sub-zone aimed at strengthening the organization of its members and improving their living conditions. Mr. Mezekir Girmay, Acting Head of the Association’s branch in the Northern Red Sea Region, said that the objective of the meeting was to assess the overall situation of war-disabled veterans and create a conducive environment for strengthening their organization at the administrative area level. He also indicated that strong organization plays an important role in alleviating socio-economic challenges. Mr. Mezekir further noted that activities focusing on organizing members, covering medical expenses, providing loans and developing capacities have been carried out in Massawa sub-zone, yielding encouraging results. He also expressed appreciation to those who contributed to the implementation of the programs. Mr. Rezene Feshaha, Director General of the Social Services Department in the Northern Red Sea Region, on his part, called on war-disabled veterans to strengthen their organizational capacity and cooperation with relevant institutions to create favorable conditions for improving their livelihoods and addressing their challenges. The participants, on their part, called for reinforced efforts to implement programs aimed at improving the livelihoods of war-disabled veterans, giving due attention to challenges associated with age and climatic conditions, addressing shortcomings in the distribution of materials provided by supporting organizations, and resolving problems encountered in the provision of loans. They also presented various comments and recommendations. The National Association of Eritrean War-Disabled Veterans has 439 members in Massawa sub-zone.
